name: HGH stack

card.summary: A combination of growth hormone, or growth-hormone-releasing peptides, with other compounds that forum users pursue for height, leaner body composition, recovery and a more muscular physique.
card.note: Growth hormone is prescription-only; non-medical use carries documented side effects and legal restrictions.

quick.overview:
An HGH stack is the forum term for pairing human growth hormone, or peptides that stimulate the body's own growth hormone release, with other substances. People discuss stacks for several appearance goals: added height in younger users, a leaner and more muscular physique, and faster recovery from training or injury.

Research on growth hormone in healthy adults shows reduced body fat and increased lean mass, but not clear gains in strength, and some of the lean-mass change may be fluid. Evidence for added height in people without a growth disorder is limited to the approved medical indication of short stature; looksmaxxing forum users themselves disagree about whether peptide stacks produce growth.
quick.how: On forums, stacks are described as growth hormone alone or combined with secretagogue peptides such as ipamorelin or CJC-1295, and sometimes with testosterone or other compounds, usually self-injected. Users trade opinions about what to add, and discussion often involves teenagers asking whether growth plates are open. Dosing and sourcing are not covered here.
quick.risks: Growth hormone is a prescription medicine in the US and distributing or using it without a prescription is illegal. Long-term high use is associated with acromegaly-like symptoms, fluid retention, joint pain and insulin resistance. Forum members themselves warn younger posters about long-term effects and about gray-market products.

lead: An HGH stack is a term from looksmaxxing and bodybuilding forums for combining human growth hormone (HGH), or growth hormone secretagogue peptides, with other compounds in pursuit of appearance goals [1][2]. The goals discussed include extra height while growth plates remain open, a leaner and fuller physique, and improved recovery that lets people train harder [3][4].

The forum conversation is varied. Some posters describe stacks of a secretagogue pair for several months, while others reply that no one has grown taller on peptides and that higher-dose growth hormone is the only option with any effect [2]. Younger posters ask whether to choose peptides or HGH for height or bone mass and voice concern about long-term effects [3].
Research on growth hormone in sport reports reduced body fat and increased lean mass but no clear strength gain, with the lean-mass change possibly reflecting short-term fluid retention [5].

chain: Growth hormone or secretagogues raise GH signalling
Lean mass up, body fat down; in growing teens, possible effect on growth
Leaner, fuller look; claimed height gain
angle.text: Users stack growth hormone to look leaner and more muscular, and some younger users hope for extra height before growth plates close. Research supports a fat-loss and lean-mass effect in adults while evidence for strength or height gain in healthy people is limited.

paras: There is no single standardised HGH stack. The phrase covers combinations discussed on looksmax.org and T Nation: growth hormone together with other peptides, or secretagogue peptides alone, sometimes with testosterone for physique goals [2][3][6]. Secretagogues such as sermorelin, ipamorelin and CJC-1295 are described by forum users as prompting the pituitary to release growth hormone rather than supplying it [7].

On looksmax.org, threads titled as stacks come from posters of varying ages asking what to add. One teenage poster lists current and planned compounds and asks what else to try, and replies focus on body fat rather than the stack [1]. Another thread about peptides for height draws a reply that "no person here grew on peptides" [2]. A user planning to check whether growth plates are open asks for a recommendation between peptides and HGH, citing worry about long-term effects [3].
On T Nation, adult lifters discuss growth hormone alongside testosterone for fat loss and recovery from surgery, and debate how different secretagogues work together [6][7].

The Wikipedia review of growth hormone in sports says studies found reduced body fat and increased lean body mass but no gain in strength, and that the lean-mass increase may reflect fluid retention [5]. It cites a 2008 meta-analysis concluding that claims of enhanced physical performance are not supported by the scientific literature, and says claims that it aids injury recovery remain speculative [5].

In medicine, growth hormone treats growth hormone deficiency in children and adults and several other conditions; in deficient adults it improves muscle, fat and bone density [8]. A 2003 New England Journal of Medicine commentary raised concern about advertising of HGH-releasing supplements for healthy adults, noting no evidence of safety or efficacy [8].

Long-term use may produce acromegaly-like symptoms such as swollen hands and feet, joint pain, fluid retention and sweating, and growth hormone typically reduces insulin sensitivity [5][8]. In the US it is a prescription medicine and non-prescribed distribution or use is illegal; the IOC banned it in 1989 [5]. Recombinant HGH is difficult to distinguish from natural hormone, which complicates testing [5].
No studies found on the combined stacks as discussed on forums. Studies of growth hormone alone in healthy people are summarised above [5].

timeline.event: IOC bans growth hormone in sport [5]
NEJM raises concerns about HGH-releasing supplement advertising [8]

lore.intro: Posters on looksmax.org and T Nation discuss stacks for height, leanness and recovery, with frequent disagreement about what works [1][2][3].

claims.claim: Peptide or HGH stacks can add height
claims.believers: Younger posters ask which stack maximises growth while plates are open [3].
claims.experts: Growth hormone is approved to treat growth disorders; for healthy people, supplement advertising claims have drawn concern in medical journals [8].

claims.claim: Growth hormone improves body composition and recovery
claims.believers: T Nation posters describe pairing it with other compounds for fat loss and surgical recovery [6].
claims.experts: Studies report lower body fat and more lean mass but no strength gain; the recovery claim remains speculative [5].

claims.believers: Some looksmax.org users say nobody grows from peptide stacks and that HGH at higher intake is the only version with any effect [2].
claims.experts: No published trial has tested these stacks for height in healthy people.
